proposals.evidence: Turner’s second aṅguṣṭhya branch, *aṅguṣṭhiya, explicitly includes Punjabi aṅgūṭhī, Nepali/Bihari aũṭhi, Bengali āṅṭi and the Gujarati/Marathi ring forms. Responses with Persian-type -starī or extra unidentified words are excluded.
